description: Settlement Rescue: 'payment weird? give it to us.' Timeout, 5xx or no PAYMENT-RESPONSE after paying, and you must decide whether to pay again. Send the X-PAYMENT header you sent (or the tx hash, or payer + payee + amount). We read the EIP-3009 authorization's on-chain state on Base: SETTLED (nonce used: here is the tx, do NOT pay again) / NOT_SETTLED (expired unused: safe to pay again ONCE) / STILL_UNCERTAIN (unused but still valid: a facilitator can still settle it, do NOT sign a new one yet, with seconds left) / NOT_FOUND_ON_CHAIN, plus a duplicate-payment scan, a safe next action and a signed record for refunds and disputes. Read-only. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/settlement/rescue, $0.05 via x402.)
